summary: A reprint must preserve DataForSEO's task-array request shape, application-level status validation, safe task polling, reachable snapshot commands, credential and MCP filesystem boundaries, and append-only observation history.
reason: DataForSEO can bill task POSTs, report failures inside HTTP-success envelopes, require formatted GET result paths, and reuse stable keyword IDs across observations; treating it like a conventional object-body REST API or dropping hand-written command wiring causes duplicate spend, silent failures, stalled polling, unreachable workflows, empty deltas, and unsafe local-tool access.
validated_outcome: Focused regression suites cover exact request bodies, logical failures, retry counts, uncached task GETs, SSRF rejection, credential clearing, local FTS, response ingestion, and historical deltas.
